# Production install entry point for Railway. Do not edit: the lock is
# backend/requirements.txt, compiled from backend/requirements.in.
#
# Railway runs `pip install -r requirements.txt` from the repo root, so this
# line makes the build install the hashed lock (pip turns hash checking on by
# itself for a file with hashes) before anything else. The engine is then
# installed with `pip install --no-deps .` (railway.json), so every dependency
# it has comes from the lock and none is resolved fresh.
-r backend/requirements.txt
